name: Fear The Unknown - Jamie Story
detailed_description:
Fear the unknown ,In the game, you will play as one of the lucky ones who met them and survived.

This is a very rare case stories like this almost never reach us.

Only a few people were lucky enough to survive an encounter with Them and tell what happened.

Powerful forces try to hide these stories and make sure they are forgotten in the vast space around us.

We’re doing our best to collect the pieces and put the puzzle together to see the full picture.

Fear The Unknown : Jamie Story

Jamie, a young and successful man, is forced to leave the big city and his business to help his father solve problems on the family farm.

In addition to revisiting familiar places and memories from his childhood, Jamie is faced with an unexpected encounter with "Them".

Can he survive such a meeting, or will it change everything? This story will reveal the answer.

The Gameplay

This game offers a first-person narrative experience, ufo horrror, blending walking simulation with elements of exploration, driving, drinking, and interactive conversations. It is a short game about UFO and aliens and is very inspired by x-files series, with approximately 45 minutes of gameplay.

Game Control

  • ASDW - Movements

  • [LMB] - Action

  • [RMB] - Task help

  • [F] - Flashlight

  • Support GamePad
